anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the report view's workspace-switch filter policy use?

A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across workspace switches.
C) Restore each workspace's last filters when switching back to it.

Recommendation: B - the workspace-change handler in `ui/report-view.ts` already keeps active filters, so the policy can match current behavior with no change for existing users and no new per-workspace filter state.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
How should the report view handle filters when switching workspaces?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: B - it preserves current behavior and avoids adding per-workspace filter state.
